user.title: NSPanel Lovelace UI
user.description:
Panels and cards are configured in a YAML file in the Home Assistant configuration folder (same format as the add-on's panels.yaml). To migrate, enter your AppDaemon apps.yaml (or an add-on panels.yaml) as the import file; it is converted into the configuration file, which must not exist yet.

{error}

data_description.config_file: Path relative to the configuration folder, e.g. nspanel_lovelace_ui/panels.yaml.
data_description.import_file: Path relative to the configuration folder, e.g. appdaemon/apps/apps.yaml.

reconfigure.title: NSPanel Lovelace UI
reconfigure.description:
Change the configuration file or import another one.

{error}

data_description.config_file: Path relative to the configuration folder, e.g. nspanel_lovelace_ui/panels.yaml.
data_description.import_file: Path relative to the configuration folder, e.g. appdaemon/apps/apps.yaml.

error.config_exists: The configuration file already exists. Choose another path or clear the import field.
error.invalid_config: The configuration is invalid (see the message above).
error.mqtt_not_configured: The MQTT integration is not set up. Add it first, or set use_ha_api: true for the ESPHome firmware.
error.path_outside_config: Files must be inside the Home Assistant configuration folder.

abort.already_configured: NSPanel Lovelace UI is already set up. Add panels to the configuration file.
abort.single_instance_allowed: NSPanel Lovelace UI is already set up. Add panels to the configuration file.

no_firmware_package.message: No display firmware package in nspanel_lovelace_ui/firmware (see the documentation).

panel_not_reported.message: The panel has not reported its display version and model yet. Wait until it starts.

no_firmware_for_model.message: The firmware package has no .tft for the display model {model}.

no_http_url.message: No plain HTTP address of Home Assistant that the panel can download from. Set firmware_base_url in panels.yaml, e.g. http://192.168.1.10:8123.

no_berry_driver.message: The firmware package contains no Berry driver.

not_loaded.message: NSPanel Lovelace UI is not loaded.

flash_timeout.message: The display did not restart with the new firmware within {minutes} minutes. Check the Tasmota console (FlashNextion).

reload.name: Reload
reload.description: Re-reads the panel configuration file and restarts all panels.

update_berry_driver.name: Update Berry driver
update_berry_driver.description: Sends the Berry driver (autoexec.be) from the local firmware package to the Tasmota panels; they restart afterwards.

panel.name: Panel
panel.description: Panel name from panels.yaml. Empty: all panels.

config_warnings.title: Warnings in the NSPanel configuration

firmware_invalid.title: Invalid NSPanel display firmware package
firmware_invalid.description:
The package in {folder} was ignored: {error}

Create it again with scripts/make_firmware_package.py or remove the folder, then reload the integration.
